name: Ghost Walker Mortimer

intro.text: Good evening. Do you know what lurks on the 199 steps at dusk? Tourists. But if you look closely, you can also see... where did my bowler hat go? It was on the bench a minute ago.

win: Splendid. I'll put you in the tour: 'the Visitor Who Won'.
after: The 199 steps are haunted by the ghost of a legend, a black hound with burning eyes, the Barghest. It was right behind me on the way up. Please check.
